title: Shapley Attribution Bounds for Co-Adopted Policies in Panels with Monotone Submodular Responses
banked_reason: D0.5 math and decision panels passed with no findings, but the delivered tier is incremental below the field novelty floor (paper score ceiling 5.5 < 7.4); the general recovery frontier remains open.
gap_reasons: The general theorem proves only that an all-or-none block permits zero credit and reduces its upper endpoint to a contracted optimization; positive recovery is characterized solely for the fixed three-policy family D3 in a strict open parameter region.

The framing accurately labels the general frontier as open, yet the delivered combination of a broad negative block result and one fully solved three-policy configuration remains a narrow specialized contribution, constraining the projected leading-journal score.

proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived the all-or-none block obstruction, a complete three-policy completion geometry, sharp attribution bounds, and same-observed-law causal witnesses. After a scoped cleanup, both D0.5 panels passed with no findings, but the field novelty gate rated the delivered result incremental. The arbitrary-K two-chain recovery frontier remains open; no Lean formalization was attempted.
tldr: For any positive-support switch and contemporaneous same-baseline stayer, the panel contrast identifies the normalized endpoint difference without requiring an inclusion ordering; connectivity of the observed edge graph to \(\varnothing\) identifies the normalized response on every observed bundle. Persistent all-or-none co-adoption still permits zero individual Shapley credit, whereas one overlapping third chain yields, for \(K=3\), a complete compatible polytope, positive sharp Shapley lower bounds, an identified feasible-context marginal, and sharp weighted-context bounds. The strengthened same-law causal-sharpness proposition proves that every algebraic completion has a witness preserving the entire observed panel law exactly when \(0\le\mu_{g\ell}+\beta\) and \(\mu_{g\ell}+\beta+d+c-\delta\le1\) for every \(g,\ell\); under these inequalities the full joint Shapley and contextual causal images equal their algebraic images. The contribution remains this observation-geometry and recovery specialization. The general overlap frontier is explicitly open and supplies no generic rate, complexity, or algorithmic claim.
gap: Several-treatment panel methods explain contamination and identify supported switches, while incomplete-game and submodular-extension papers study merger values, feasibility, or Shapley projections under different information structures. They do not characterize the member attribution left by all-or-none adoption chains or the exact recovery created by one overlapping bundle chain under a common monotone-submodular mean response.
fill: The block theorem proves the exact zero-to-contracted-value interval with carrier lifts. The three-chain theorem eliminates every missing response coordinate and certifies the sharp Shapley and contextual endpoints. A separate proposition supplies same-observed-law causal witnesses exactly for endpoint tables satisfying the baseline-adjusted outcome-support inequalities under assignment support on the observed bundle family.
